tool_args.prompt: Create ONE complete isolated Armadura from ORIGINAL Resident Evil 4 (2005), using ONLY the large black-and-gold armor variant in the foreground center of the first reference and the same black/gold enemy in the second gameplay reference. Keep the original slightly angular textured 2005 game aesthetic; do not replace it with a modern medieval design or remake asset. Include the entire ONE armor, the plume tip, both pointed feet, shaft butt, spear point and all edges of the axe head. Scale the entire subject plus weapon down until there is at least 10 percent real transparent margin on every edge. True transparent alpha; no floor, cast backdrop shadow, scene, wall, glow, UI, watermark, labels, text, border, additional subject or animation grid.
